events.name: The Old Man's Lesson
events.intro: Outside the Poké Mart a very old man dozes on a crate, an empty coffee cup in his hand. "Ah, a new trainer. Let me show you how catching is done."

success.text: He tosses a ball at a startled Weedle and it clicks shut. "Gentle hands, that is the secret." He gives you the Weedle, a Catching Charm and a handful of Poké Balls.

effects.label: Catching Charm: the first wild Poké Ball is 25% better

failure.text: He has not had his coffee. "Catch it yourself!" he yelps, and the Weedle charges you.

win.label: Catching Charm: the first wild Poké Ball is 25% better

success.text: You tiptoe past. He snores on.

events.name: Route 22: The Rival
events.intro: The road to the League gate. A guard blocks it. "Come back when the whole region has heard of you." Your rival steps out of the tall grass, grinning.

success.text: "Let's see if you're any good!"

events.name: Route 22: The Final Rematch
events.intro: Back at the gate where it began. The guard steps aside for you now, but your rival is waiting on the road, stronger than ever. "One more. For old times."

success.text: Nobody speaks. Then the first ball flies.

events.name: Viridian Mart: The Parcel
events.intro: The clerk waves you over. "Oak ordered something. Could you drop this parcel at the next Pokémon Center?"

success.text: You tuck it under your arm and head for the Center.
"Suit yourself."

events.name: Viridian Mart: The Delivery
events.intro: The Pokémon Center is just ahead. The parcel feels light in your hands.

success.text: The nurse beams and gives you the Pokédex Upgrade, a Devon Scope that shows the wild Pokémon waiting at the next stops.

failure.text: A Rattata or Meowth snatches the parcel and bolts!

events.name: Viridian Trainer School
events.intro: A classroom of chalk and diagrams. The teacher taps the blackboard. "Three questions. Get them right and you will battle better."

success.text: Pencils up!
Detention is for other people.

events.name: Trainer School: Question 1
events.intro: "Question one. Which type is super effective against Water?"

success.text: Not quite. The teacher sighs and moves on.
Correct! A gold star, and a little something extra for your lead.
Not quite. The teacher sighs and moves on.

events.name: Trainer School: Question 2
events.intro: "Question two. Which type cannot hurt a Ground-type at all?"

success.text: Correct! A gold star, and a little something extra for your lead.
Not quite. The teacher sighs and moves on.
Not quite. The teacher sighs and moves on.

events.name: Trainer School: Question 3
events.intro: "Last question. Which type is Grass weak to?"

success.text: Not quite. The teacher sighs and moves on.
Not quite. The teacher sighs and moves on.
Correct! A gold star, and a little something extra for your lead.

events.name: Diglett's Cave
events.intro: A tunnel mouth pocked with fresh holes. Dirt keeps popping up from the ground ahead.

success.text: The dirt shakes under your feet.
You back away from the holes.

events.name: Diglett's Cave: Swarm
events.intro: Holes everywhere. Heads pop up from every one.

success.text: A swarm of Diglett pops up!

events.name: Diglett's Cave: Deeper
events.intro: The tunnel narrows. The ground ahead is moving.

success.text: More Diglett burst out of the walls.

failure.text: The tunnel breaks into a warm den. A Sandshrew rolls out to defend it.

events.name: Diglett's Cave: The Dugtrio
events.intro: At the far end, a Dugtrio rises from the dirt and stares you down.

success.text: It does not blink.

events.name: Diglett's Cave: The Burrow
events.intro: Behind the Dugtrio there is a deep burrow with something shining in it.

success.text: A special Dugtrio crawls out, shaking sand off its fur. It wants to come along!

failure.text: Just sand. Still, the Soft Sand was a good find.

events.name: Victory Road
events.intro: The last road before the Indigo Plateau. Cave mouths, loose boulders and every strong trainer who made it this far.

success.text: The wind drops as the cave swallows you.

events.name: Victory Road: First Cave
events.intro: A Hiker blocks the tunnel, rubbing his hands. "Rock-hard, that is me!"

success.text: "Let's rumble!"

events.name: Victory Road: Boulders
events.intro: A boulder sits in the only way forward. There may be a trick to it.

success.text: You set your shoulder to it and it rolls into the hole. The way is open.

failure.text: It will not budge. You squeeze through a crack and scrape your team up.

success.text: Tight, but you make it.

events.name: Victory Road: Fighters
events.intro: A Black Belt stands in a pool of light. "No shortcuts here."

success.text: "Hai!"

events.name: Victory Road: Boulders
events.intro: A boulder sits in the only way forward. There may be a trick to it.

success.text: You set your shoulder to it and it rolls into the hole. The way is open.

failure.text: It will not budge. You squeeze through a crack and scrape your team up.

success.text: Tight, but you make it.

events.name: Victory Road: The Last Stand
events.intro: At the top of the road a familiar figure waits on the ledge. "I was not going to let you pass me. Not now."

success.text: "This is everything I have got."

choices.label: Whistle for the Pidgeot that left

success.text: A great shape drops out of the sky and lands beside you. It remembers.

events.name: Victory Road: Boulders
events.intro: A boulder sits in the only way forward. There may be a trick to it.

success.text: You set your shoulder to it and it rolls into the hole. The way is open.

failure.text: It will not budge. You squeeze through a crack and scrape your team up.

success.text: Tight, but you make it.

events.name: Victory Road: The Summit
events.intro: A ring of fire on the peak. Something huge is circling above the flames.

success.text: Moltres, King of the Flames, dives out of the sky!

failure.text: A mighty Arcanine guards the peak and snarls at you.

events.name: Cerulean Cave
events.intro: Beyond the summit a crack in the mountain leads down to a cave that glows pale blue. A voice with no mouth says: this place is closed.

success.text: Cold air rolls up from the dark.
You decide some secrets are better left alone.

events.name: Cerulean Cave: Mewtwo
events.intro: At the end of the cave something waits that was never meant to be caught. "You should not be here."

success.text: Mewtwo lifts its head. The cave goes silent.

events.name: Cerulean Cave: Second Visit
events.intro: Mewtwo does not run. It watches you and waits. This time it feels like a question.

success.text: It meets you with calm eyes. This time it can be caught.

win.text: Earned the Kanto Secret title in Cerulean Cave.

success.text: Some things are better left unfought.

effects.text: Earned the Kanto Secret title in Cerulean Cave.

events.name: Snorlax Blockade
events.intro: A Snorlax sleeps right across the road. The ground shakes every time it snores.

success.text: It wakes, yawns, and ambles aside. As it goes, it drops a snack and decides to follow you.
You poke it. It opens one eye, then both.
You find another way, a long one.

events.name: Charizard Valley
events.intro: A high plateau where Charizard soar and their trainers train. A banner reads: three wins earns a feather.

success.text: Heat rolls over the rocks.
You leave them to their flying.

events.name: Charizard Valley: Fire Spitter
events.intro: A trainer on the ledge calls down: "Feather's yours if you can win it."

success.text: Wings snap open overhead.

events.name: Charizard Valley: Wing Rider
events.intro: A trainer on the ledge calls down: "Feather's yours if you can win it."

success.text: Wings snap open overhead.

events.name: Charizard Valley: Valley Keeper
events.intro: A trainer on the ledge calls down: "Feather's yours if you can win it."

success.text: Wings snap open overhead.

events.name: Charizard Valley: The Feathers
events.intro: Three feathers in your hand glow orange. A huge Charizard lands and presses its snout to them.

success.text: Its eyes soften. It leaves a fire-red stone at your feet.

failure.text: It snorts, warm and approving, and takes off.

events.name: Pidgeotto's Farewell
events.intro: A Pidgeotto circles overhead, gazing at the sky and at you. It is ready to go home.

success.text: It nuzzles you, then rises into the sky. "We will meet again," it seems to say.
It settles back on your shoulder.

events.name: Pidgeotto's Farewell: Goodbye
events.intro: It is a Pidgeot's cry that you will hear on the road to the Plateau.

success.text: The speck of a bird vanishes into the clouds.

events.name: Bulbasaur's Gathering
events.intro: At night the trees open up and a ring of Bulbasaur dances in the moonlight. One of them beckons you in.

success.text: Your steps match theirs. They welcome you with a gift.

failure.text: You stumble. They scatter, giggling, and leave a berry behind.

success.text: You leave them to their dance.

events.name: Haunter's Mansion
events.intro: A broken-down house glows with party lights. A Haunter floats at the door, giggling. "Come in!"

success.text: You laugh at the pranks and clap at the tricks. Haunter hands you a Spell Tag and floats to your side.

failure.text: The joke is on you. You are soaked in cold slime and everyone's spirits dip.

success.text: Haunter's grin widens.

events.name: The Pikachu Who Hates Evolving
events.intro: A Thunder Stone lies in the grass. It buzzes softly.

success.text: Pikachu shoves the stone away and beams at you. It will stay as it is, and it hands you a Light Ball.
There is a flash. Raichu stares at you and sulks.
It will come in handy.

events.name: Lapras's Song
events.intro: At night, a sad song drifts over the water. A Lapras sings alone on the coast.

success.text: It follows you along the shore, singing softly. Then the poachers appear.
The song stops.
The song fades behind you.

events.name: Pokémon Tournament Poster
events.intro: A wall poster in bold print: a tournament will be held in a later town. Entrants only.

success.text: You note the date, the rules and the prizes.

events.name: Route 1: Pidgey Rush
events.intro: The tall grass erupts. A flock of Pidgey and a pack of Rattata come at you at once.

success.text: Here they come!
You skirt the grass.

events.name: Route 2: The Cut Tree
events.intro: A small tree blocks a narrow side path. Beyond it, something glints.

success.text: One clean slice. Behind the tree: potions and a tidy little clearing.
A single stroke, and the tree falls in two. Behind it: potions and a tidy clearing.
No time to dig around.

events.name: Route 3: The Tough Junior
events.intro: A Junior Trainer crosses his arms. "I'm tough! Beat me and I will give you a Potion!"

success.text: "Here I come!"
"Chicken!"

events.name: Route 12: Fishing Contest
events.intro: Rods in the water as far as the eye can see. A judge calls: "Biggest catch wins a Super Rod!"

success.text: Your line goes taut. You haul in a monster, and the judge hands over the Super Rod.

failure.text: A Magikarp. The judge gives you an honourable mention and a Potion.

success.text: Not today.

events.name: Route 15: The Stone Seller
events.intro: A seller spreads stones on a cloth. "Evolution stones! Rare! Cheap! Well, not that cheap."

success.text: A fair deal.
He laughs and halves the price. "You drive a hard bargain!"

failure.text: "Not a coin less." He packs up his cloth.

success.text: You keep your wallet shut.

events.name: Route 16: Cycling Road
events.intro: A long downhill road. Bikers whoop past. One of them shouts: "Race me! Winner takes a prize!"

success.text: You tear down the slope with the wind in your face and beat them all.

failure.text: They leave you in a cloud of dust.

success.text: You keep to the shoulder.

events.name: Route 18: The Biker Gang
events.intro: A gang of bikers blocks the road. The spray-painted badge on their jackets looks familiar.

success.text: They rev their engines and swarm.
You wait until they look away.

events.name: Route 23: The Badge Check
events.intro: A guard stands at the gate to Victory Road. "Badges, please."

success.text: The guard whistles. "Go on through, champ, the short way."
"Not enough. Come back when the whole region has heard of you."

events.name: The Balloon in the Sky
events.intro: High above the trees a balloon drifts by. A voice you almost know carries on the wind: "To protect the world from devastation..."

success.text: It is gone behind the clouds. You jot down what you heard.

events.name: Safari Zone: The Net
events.intro: In the Safari Zone, three figures try to net a Tauros. The net tangles around them instead.

success.text: "Not you again!"
You watch the Tauros trample their net and run off. They glare at you, then at each other.
